knowledge_graph.title: South Paulding High School
knowledge_graph.type: Public school in Paulding County, Georgia
knowledge_graph.description: South Paulding High School is a public high school located in Paulding County, Georgia, United States. Opened in 2006, South Paulding is a part of the Paulding County School District. Beginning its second year, a 12th grade class was added and the student body was composed of 1657 students.
